name: Many unrelated senders paying a single account or recipient
description: Numerous unrelated payers send frequent, often small, payments to one account, wallet or beneficiary, or one funder pays many beneficiaries, with no clear commercial relationship.
fp: Legitimate retailers, charities, marketplaces and payroll can show high payer counts.

links.name: Vendor-style inflows from many unrelated senders
links.ctx: Account receives numerous small transfers from unconnected wallets then consolidates and sends onward in large amounts.

links.name: Many senders paying one beneficiary or many beneficiaries paid by one sender
links.ctx: Fan-in or fan-out structures with no family or business link.

links.name: Inbound payments from many unrelated sources, outbound to crypto or abroad
links.ctx: Accounts act as aggregation points for third-party funds, then pay out to exchanges.

links.name: Many low-value in-game transfers from unrelated accounts to one account
links.ctx: Fan-in of small gifts or trades into a single collector, then withdrawal.

links.name: Cards funded by many unrelated third parties
links.ctx: Multiple unconnected payers load one card or small set of cards.

links.name: Many small inflows from unrelated individuals into one account
links.ctx: Operator-side: numerous retail credits referencing the 'investment' or a referral code, inconsistent with the stated business.

links.name: Pattern of many small payments from many accounts to one recipient
links.ctx: Facilitator receives many micro-payments from unrelated senders.

links.name: Many accounts funding a few betting accounts or agents
links.ctx: Pooling of funds to bookmakers or agents.
